As a former British colony, India is a member of the Commonwealth of Nations and continues to maintain relationships with other Commonwealth countries.  == History == India's relations with the world have evolved since the British Raj (1857–1947) when the British Empire took responsibility for handling external and defence relations.  When India gained independence in 1947, few Indians had experience in making or conducting foreign policy.
